region.//: Stand-in lowlands biome for the first plane (S4 plumbing).  Vanilla terrain as placeholder until the T1 theme bill lands.  2026-10-01 dominant-biome floors: ~85 % of the land is this biome; the rest is painted from the listed regions (`default` = overworld plains, forest and ordinary swamp) in contiguous patches, weights falling with distance in the route.  Floor 2 is heavily watered: astral_drowned river and lake settings.

biome_mix.//: Weights from Grok's WP-B5 table (2026-10-02): overworld plains/forest/thick/swamp summed into `default`.
